tickets.title: The action answer names its outcome record and a pre-admission failure counts in the monitor (**amendment 7, 2026-10-20**)

authority.locator: P64 · section 2 of amendment 7; OUT-K3 §4 'optional product unit' and §5
authority.requirement: see amendment 7 section 2, ticket P64 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: A storefront developer or an operator can see, from the action's own answer, which outcome record an accepted event produced, and the monitor shows when an accepted event produced none.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, a tracked action with a reward answers 200 with outcome.recordId equal to the outcome id the engine stores (built from the engine time the behaviour record carries); the ledger read of that id returns 200 after the effects settle.
criteria.proof: The P64 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P64.OT1 in src/units/P64 and they pass.

criteria.observable: A dropped event, a tracking-refused event and an action without a reward carry no outcome member.
criteria.proof: The P64 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P64.OT2 in src/units/P64 and they pass.

criteria.observable: A failure before the outcome's durable admission increments the tenant's producerFailed lost-evidence counter once and is logged; the answer's status is unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P64 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P64.OT3 in src/units/P64 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Locks: the clamp, the outcome_id format, the behavior member, the status codes, amendment 5's answer-at-admission (no new remote call before the answer under the latency lever) and the units P56–P60 unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P64 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P64.OT4 in src/units/P64 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.

existingEvidence.description: The path traced and the reset case reproduced locally at two shas; the untyped native crossings read in the code.

remainingWork: emitOutcome returns the outcome id it built; the answer adds outcome: { recordId }; recordEvidenceLoss(…, 'producerFailed', 1) in outcomeToLearning's catch.

decisions.authorityRef: R-P119 and the P58/P60 reviews (_evidence/parity-step3/AMENDMENTS.md) under the owner's standing rule R-P78
decisions.effect: Named on the answer, never on the record.

tickets.title: The outcome survives a reset between the behaviour capture's admission and its own (**amendment 7, 2026-10-20**)

authority.locator: P65 · section 2 of amendment 7; OUT-K3 §2 case b1 and §4 'gap b1'
authority.requirement: see amendment 7 section 2, ticket P65 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: An accepted tracked action never ends with a behaviour record and no outcome record because the shopper's object reset at the wrong moment.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, a reset injected between the behaviour capture's durable admission and the outcome's leaves, after the alarm, exactly one behaviour record and one outcome record with the unit's content (today: the behaviour record only).
criteria.proof: The P65 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P65.RS1 in src/units/P65 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The client's answer in that case is the route's typed reset answer, never a silent 200 without an outcome.
criteria.proof: The P65 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P65.RS2 in src/units/P65 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Locks: W06's digests, the idempotent replay, amendment 5's answer-at-admission and the P56–P60, P64 units unchanged; no new remote call before the answer under the latency lever.
criteria.proof: The P65 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P65.RS3 in src/units/P65 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.

existingEvidence.description: The path traced and the reset case reproduced locally at two shas; the untyped native crossings read in the code.

remainingWork: Admit the outcome within the behaviour capture's durable admission (one transaction) or make the behaviour's admission carry the pending outcome so the alarm writes both; the specifier chooses inside fail-closed.

decisions.authorityRef: R-P119 and the P58/P60 reviews (_evidence/parity-step3/AMENDMENTS.md) under the owner's standing rule R-P78
decisions.effect: The mechanism is the specifier's choice inside fail-closed; the observable is one behaviour and one outcome record after the alarm.

tickets.title: The account-change and absorb merges' refusals cross the object boundary typed (**amendment 7, 2026-10-20**)

authority.locator: P66 · section 2 of amendment 7; the P58 delivery review finding 2
authority.requirement: see amendment 7 section 2, ticket P66 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: A client error in any identity merge reaches the shopper as the route's own 400 with its details on the deployed runtime, never an untyped 500.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, in process and natively, a validation refusal raised in the account object during the account-change merge reaches the shopper as the route's own 400 Validation error with the same issues (today natively: an untyped 500).
criteria.proof: The P66 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P66.TC1 in src/units/P66 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The same for the absorb merge.
criteria.proof: The P66 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P66.TC2 in src/units/P66 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Locks: the typed shape is produced only by the account object's doors and accepted only at status 400 with the exact shape (P58's validationRefusalOf); no message string parsed; the oversized link merge (P58 BA4) unchanged; P58's units unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P66 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P66.TC3 in src/units/P66 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.

existingEvidence.description: The path traced and the reset case reproduced locally at two shas; the untyped native crossings read in the code.

remainingWork: Type the refusal at handleAccountChange / handleAbsorb as P58 did at the transfer door; applyAccountChange and the absorb caller in link.ts read the typed answer.
